name: aws-granted
title: AWS Granted
description: Open the AWS Console via Granted, with fuzzy search for profiles, services and regions.
author: AdamKaplun

commands.name: open-console
commands.title: Open AWS Console
commands.subtitle: Granted
commands.description: Pick an AWS profile, then a service (and optionally a region), and open the console with `assume -c`.

preferences.name: defaultRegion
preferences.title: Default Region
preferences.description: Region used when you don't pick one explicitly.

preferences.name: useProfileRegion
preferences.label: Prefer the profile's own region
preferences.title: Profile Region
preferences.description: If a profile in ~/.aws/config sets `region`, use it instead of the default region.

preferences.name: includeAwsCliProfiles
preferences.label: Also ask `aws configure list-profiles`
preferences.title: AWS CLI Profiles
preferences.description: Merge profiles reported by the AWS CLI (slower; the config files are always read).
